description: FAO-56 reference ET0 on Moroccan gridded weather, published-case checks and explicit hypothetical Kc scenarios

issues.title: Validate gridded ET0 and humidity approximation against observations
issues.body: Current RH mean approximates actual vapour pressure; no observed ET target exists. Obtain independent station RH extremes and reference ET or lysimeter observations before making accuracy claims.

issues.title: Define an observed crop calendar and soil water budget
issues.body: Kc values .4/.8/1.2 are constant hypothetical scenarios. Obtain crop-stage coefficients, rooting depth, retention, effective rainfall and observed management before converting reference demand to irrigation advice.
